title: DeepSeek launching v4.1 flash cheaper and more capable than v4 pro
summary: DeepSeek announces V4.1 Flash model release around September 10, 2026, claiming comprehensive superiority over V4 Pro in performance, cost, speed, and task completion time. As a user-friendly strategy, all V4 Pro requests will be routed to V4.1 Flash at Flash pricing until V4.1 Pro launches.
problem_solved: Provides a more cost-effective and higher-performing AI model alternative to the previous Pro version.
why_valuable: Offers better performance at lower cost with faster response times, democratizing access to advanced AI capabilities.
